title: Chicken, broccoli and pea pasta bake

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Pasta, crème fraîche, mustard, cheddar, chicken and breadcrumbs are all ordinary home ingredients.

supermarket.reason: Everything, including peas in the pod and fresh tarragon in June, is sold at mainstream supermarkets at everyday prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a pan, colander, grater and baking dish, and the technique is simple.

works.reason: Part-boiled penne finishes in the oven, and thin chicken strips cook through in 25 minutes at 200°C, giving a sensible bake for four.

honest_times.reason: 18 minutes covers podding the peas, slicing the chicken, grating and zesting, and 32 minutes matches the 6-minute boil plus the 25-minute bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and penne is a fair name for dried pasta.

seasonal_feel.reason: Broccoli and fresh peas with tarragon and lemon suit early June, and broccoli is named and central.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a balanced family meal with chicken, two green vegetables and pasta.
